title: MenuSync AI
one_liner: Turns a restaurant menu image into category, item and price rows with EasyOCR plus spatial line grouping, with a batch engine that writes JSON and CSV and scores itself against ground truth.

steps.text: Menu digitisation: pick the first sample menu; one click parses it
Parsed items: category, item, price, confidence
The annotated image: title, categories, items and prices found by OCR
Structured JSON for the pricing database
The batch engine over every sample menu
Files processed, items and prices found, and the accuracy against ground truth
